title: Authentication HTTP helpers
responsibility: Build uncached auth responses and validate bounded JSON requests and authentication headers.

inputs.name: authRedirect.location
inputs.description: This string is copied to the Location header of a 303 response. No URL allowlist or redirect-target normalization is applied, and a value invalid as a header can cause a TypeError.

inputs.name: authRedirect.cookies
inputs.description: Each string is appended as a separate Set-Cookie header after response creation. Defaults to []; invalid header values can cause a TypeError.

inputs.name: sameOrigin.request
inputs.description: The request whose origin header is read. A missing header compares as null and returns false.

inputs.name: sameOrigin.origin
inputs.description: The expected origin string compared exactly with the request's origin header. The value is not parsed or normalized.

inputs.name: bearerToken.request
inputs.description: The request whose authorization header is checked against the bearer-token pattern. A missing or non-matching value produces null.

inputs.name: withCookies.response
inputs.description: The response whose headers are modified in place. Its header list must permit appending values.

inputs.name: withCookies.cookies
inputs.description: Each string is appended as a separate Set-Cookie header to the response. Defaults to []; invalid header values or immutable response headers can cause a TypeError.

inputs.name: authHttp.body
inputs.description: The value passed to JSON.stringify for the response body. Cyclic values or BigInt values cause serialization to fail with TypeError.

inputs.name: authHttp.options
inputs.description: Optional AuthHttpOptions used for response status and cookies; defaults to {}. Status defaults to 200 and omitted cookies append no headers; invalid statuses or cookie/header values can fail.

inputs.name: authFailure.error
inputs.description: The value checked to determine whether it is an AuthFailure. An AuthFailure supplies its code and status; every other value becomes auth-unavailable with status 500.

inputs.name: hasAuthorization.request
inputs.description: The request whose authorization header presence is tested. The header value is not validated.

inputs.name: boundedText.body
inputs.description: A nullable byte stream consumed by the helper; null yields an empty string. Reading stops and cancels the stream once accumulated bytes exceed limit.

inputs.name: boundedText.limit
inputs.description: The maximum number of accumulated bytes before the helper returns null. No lower bound is enforced, so a nonempty body exceeds a negative limit.

inputs.name: readJson.request
inputs.description: The request must declare application/json, with optional parameters and case-insensitive matching, and its declared content length must not exceed 16384 bytes. The streamed body is also limited to 16384 bytes and must decode as UTF-8 to a non-array JSON object; otherwise it rejects with AuthFailure code invalid-request.

inputs.name: authPath.request
inputs.description: The request whose URL pathname is read. Only paths beginning with /api/auth/ or /api/github/ are returned, without the query string.

outputs.name: authHttp
outputs.description: A Response containing the JSON.stringify result, with status defaulting to 200 and no-store, nosniff, and JSON content-type headers. Cookies are appended individually; serialization or Response/header validation can fail.

outputs.name: authRedirect
outputs.description: A 303 Response with Location, no-store, nosniff, and no-referrer headers. Each supplied cookie is appended as a separate Set-Cookie header.

outputs.name: authFailure
outputs.description: An AuthFailure becomes a JSON error body containing its code and status; every other value becomes {"error":"auth-unavailable"} with status 500. The response has the no-store, nosniff, and JSON content-type headers.

outputs.name: sameOrigin
outputs.description: True only when the request's origin header exactly equals the supplied origin string; a missing header returns false.

outputs.name: hasAuthorization
outputs.description: True when the request has an authorization header, including an empty or otherwise invalid value.

outputs.name: bearerToken
outputs.description: The captured token from a full-string match of Bearer followed by one space and 32 to 128 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens; all other values return null.

outputs.name: boundedText
outputs.description: The promise resolves to decoded UTF-8 text when the stream stays within the byte limit, or null for oversized, invalid UTF-8, or failed reads. A null body resolves to an empty string.

outputs.name: readJson
outputs.description: The promise resolves to the parsed non-array JSON object. Invalid content type, declared or streamed size, UTF-8, JSON, or object shape rejects with AuthFailure code invalid-request.

outputs.name: authPath
outputs.description: The URL pathname when it begins with /api/auth/ or /api/github/, otherwise null.

errors.name: AuthFailure
errors.description: readJson rejects with code invalid-request when the content type or declared length is invalid, the body exceeds 16384 bytes, UTF-8 or JSON parsing fails, or the parsed value is not an object.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: A locked stream can make getReader reject; invalid response header values and cyclic or BigInt JSON input can also cause TypeError. These failures propagate from boundedText, authRedirect, withCookies, or authHttp when not caught by their implementations.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: Response construction can reject an authHttp status outside the supported Response status range. authHttp passes the supplied status to Response without validating it first.
